items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: another fellow named Farley Jordan, he was a trombone player. He played a little bit professional.

ctx.x: Yeah. Won the prize, and there's some who didn't. Benny Carter was along. Benny, he didn't go to the same school I did, and he didn't play in this orchestra, but he was along about that same time, and another fellow named Farley Jordan, he was a trombone player. He played a little bit professional. And there was a few of them who played, you know, professionally. Not -- they never got too big, but they played. They could play.
: Now, your first professional job, was that the Willy Freeman?
